subject: Native dispatch scope and guard authorization across structured writes and opaque shell effects.

dimensions.desc: Rejects universal dispatch scopes, represents absent child authority as an explicit empty scope, and limits root structured writes to root-level Markdown through complete native facts.
Applies one Rust-owned decision to Write, Edit/apply_patch, and opaque Bash so bounded or non-writable dispatches cannot switch carriers to escape scope.
Allows report-write only for one exact non-glob dispatch-declared output path matching the sole resolved write target.
Rejects malformed root facts and missing, null, non-string, or empty Bash commands without shell parsing, token inference, or adapter-owned policy.

guidance: Reward explicit empty non-writable scope, exact report paths, complete root facts, root-level *.md matching, universal-scope rejection, and equivalent fail-closed behavior across write carriers. Penalize invented report paths, broad report globs, lane-less ** fallbacks, missing root facts, shell parsing, safe-command allowlists, and adapter-side policy maps.
